changelog:
Initial release of the post-at CLI.

- Manage Austrian Post (post.at) deliveries: list, filter, and view details of packages.
- Set delivery place preferences (Wunschplatz) using custom or preset options.
- Supports login via environment variables or CLI options.
- Outputs delivery information in human-readable or JSON format.
- Includes command references and workflow examples for scripting and automation.
summary: Manage Austrian Post (post.at) deliveries - list packages, check delivery status, set delivery place preferences.
